name: AWS — Cross-Source AssumeRole or Cross-Account Token Issuance
xql_query:
datamodel dataset = amazon_aws_raw
| filter xdm.event.type in ("AssumeRole","AssumeRoleWithSAML","AssumeRoleWithWebIdentity")
| filter xdm.event.outcome = "SUCCESS"
| filter xdm.event.description contains "AdministratorAccess"
       or xdm.event.description contains "PowerUserAccess"
       or xdm.event.description contains "OrganizationAccountAccess"
       or xdm.event.description contains "BreakGlass"
| filter not (xdm.event.description contains "AWSServiceRoleFor"
       or xdm.event.description contains "InstanceProfile"
       or xdm.event.description contains "/aws-service-role/")
| filter xdm.source.user.username != null
| bin _time span = 1h
| comp count() as assumes,
       values(xdm.source.ipv4) as source_ips,
       values(xdm.event.description) as roles
       by xdm.source.user.username, _time
| filter assumes >= 1
| fields source_ips, xdm.source.user.username
description: AWS AssumeRole, AssumeRoleWithSAML, or AssumeRoleWithWebIdentity SUCCESS with ≥2 distinct source IPs for same role ARN within one hour — possible token replay or cross-account pivot.
alert_name: AWS — Cross-Source AssumeRole or Cross-Account Token Issuance
